title: Connection failures on cloud-api
impact: Requests failed while connections were refused on cloud-api
symptom: [ANOMALY] cloud-api 2026-08-16 16:10-20:30: cloud-api: 502 of 602 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-16 16:10 and 2026-08-16 20:30 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 1.953 s vs baseline band up to 0.453 s.
error_templates: Unexpected exception while calling meta-db: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already

_templates.macro: Terraform change to the {svc} parameter group cut max_connections {old} -> {new}; after the next reboot the services' pools exceeded it and new connections were refused.
_templates.remediation: Restore max_connections = {old} on {resource} and reboot in the maintenance window.

rca.macro: Terraform change to the meta-db parameter group cut max_connections 500 -> 100; after the next reboot the services' pools exceeded it and new connections were refused.
rca.remediation: Restore max_connections = 500 on aws_db_parameter_group.meta_db and reboot in the maintenance window.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `<*> <*> <*> HTTP/1.1" status: <*> len: <*> time: <*>`.
